title: Clinical NGS Variant Annotator & Diagnostic Pipeline
problem: Engineered an automated Python-based bioinformatics pipeline to ingest targeted NGS variant panels. Integrated the Ensembl REST API to filter out benign background SNPs and mapped disease-causing variants to severe hematological disorders.

title: Genomic Sequence Analysis & Annotation Pipeline
problem: Engineered an automated pipeline using Python and Biopython for sequence analysis. Integrated BLAST algorithms with NCBI databases for precise gene-finding, translating complex biological datasets into reproducible R scripts (ggplot2) for statistical visualization.
